why: Tests step for lead tooling slice lint-dead-test-support, on branch fabrikalfa/lint-dead-test-support from origin/main 701a651. The owner ruled that pnpm lint:dead flagging exports of *.test-support.ts files (0538) as only-called-from-tests is a gap in our node-kinds.json, not a code-graph bug. Read the installed code-graph first (0054): @demlik/code-graph 0.15.0 (pnpm-lock.yaml, with a local patch), node_modules/@demlik/code-graph/dist/index.js. There testSupportFilePatterns is a record of named groups of regular expressions, not globs, tested against each file's path from the scanned root (NodeKindRulesSchema, compileGroup, matchingRules). Its default holds two groups, test-directory and test-helper-module, with no .test-support. pattern. A matching file's exports are withheld as test-support-surface, never dead or only-called-from-tests (judge, findUnreachable). --node-kinds is read by resolveNodeKindRules and loadOverrides, which spread the file over the defaults by top-level key, so setting testSupportFilePatterns replaces both default groups unless the file writes them again. pnpm lint:dead is the root package.json script code-graph . --unreachable --ci --node-kinds node-kinds.json, gated against unreachable-ledger.json, which holds no test-support entry today. Three laws in one new file, next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/unreachable.integration.test.ts, each a fast-check property that plants a generated tree in a temp folder with the real node-kinds.json and runs the real code-graph binary (so it is an integration law, 0584). Law 1 is red on main for the planned reason: expected [ 'next/a.test-support.ts:haa' ] to deeply equal []. Laws 2 and 3 are green on main. All three are green against a saved, uncommitted node-kinds.json holding the two default groups plus test-support-module [\.test-support\.tsx?$]. Law 3 was added because the replace-not-merge rule above means a config that names only the new group drops code-graph's default helper folders.
